## Summary
Tyler chose company-scale fintech again.

## About
Affirm was company-scale engineering management. He led the marketing site and the merchant portal. When the business direction shifted, he chose to stay and see the work through. The role was eliminated later.

Beginner was a founder and DevX deep-dive, framed as fintech. He practiced fundraising through writing and met developers at founder-tech events.
